component.name: DesignCraft
component.summary: Lay out magazines, books and print documents

description.p: This is a community package of DesignCraft, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the DesignCraft project. It repackages the official upstream Linux release build unmodified.
DesignCraft is an open-source, native page layout app written in Rust that follows the Adobe InDesign workflow: the same layout, tools, menus, panels and shortcuts.

ul.li: Spreads and parent pages, frames and threaded text
A Knuth-Plass paragraph composer with dictionary hyphenation
IDML import and export, and PNG export
Fast multithreaded rendering and instant undo
Every menu item, tool and panel can be driven by AI agents

description.p: The headless command runner and MCP server is included: flatpak run --command=designcraft-cli ai.storyteller.designcraft --help

Permissions: this package uses the same sandbox as upstream's own Flatpak manifest: display (Wayland, with X11 as a fallback), the GPU device, and the Pictures folder. Files anywhere else are opened and saved through the system file chooser. No network access is granted.

ul.li: Let agents on the host reach the --control automation server: flatpak override --user --share=network ai.storyteller.designcraft
Open files by path anywhere in your home folder (command line, Open Recent): flatpak override --user --filesystem=home ai.storyteller.designcraft
